race.comment: RETURN OF THE MACH (15) closed strongly for second at this track after beginning awkwardly and striking interference from the 250m. She had also been close at Northam the run prior, is proven at this distance and reunites with Lucy Fiore, who has won twice on her, so she sets a clear benchmark. FORGOTTEN SON (8) was only a length and a half away in the same race despite being steadied at the start, and third-up with weight relief gives him the right platform to turn that into a stronger finish. A SUMMER FLING (9) brings the highest-class references, having placed in the Listed Belmont Oaks after contesting the Listed Belmont Guineas, and a solid second trial points to a forward return. PRECIOUS GOD (3) resumes off an Ascot win where she beat Tribal Ruler as a short-priced favourite, and her record around 1300m keeps her well in play if she is sharp enough fresh. FLYING SOUTH (4) was solid without a trial fresh and should be much fitter now. Can feature again.
